name: clean-mac-storage-tools
title: Clean My Mac Storage
description: Safely reclaim Mac storage and reach a concrete used-space target with history-aware protection, read-only diagnosis, approval-gated cleanup waves, and post-clean verification.
notes:
## What it does

Clean My Mac Storage diagnoses APFS and user storage, recovers protection rules from accessible conversation history, ranks rebuildable candidates, and frees only enough space to reach the requested target.

## Safety model

Every destructive wave requires explicit approval and exact targets. Photos, personal files, application state, credentials, active workspaces, Docker volumes, databases, booted simulators, current runtimes, and backups are protected by default. The workflow stops as soon as a fresh measurement crosses the target.

## Integrations

The portable Python helper is read-only and uses standard macOS commands. Docker and Xcode are optional: when present, the skill distinguishes build cache from volumes and old shutdown runtimes from current or booted simulator state. No secrets, accounts, or machine-specific paths are required.
